I have farmed this small 0.25 hectare plot for many years and I know beans do well here without chemical fertilizer because they fix their own nitrogen. I will spread manure on it since I own the land and want to keep the soil fertile, but I will use local bean seed I saved from last season because buying new seed is too expensive for such a small plot. I do not use pesticides or irrigation on beans — the rains are enough here in Zomba and chemicals cost too much. My family and I will do all the work ourselves, about 18 days over the season, because hiring labor would eat up any profit from this tiny plot.
